author: Springer, 1955

note.en: A 4 cm blenny of eroded limestone shorelines and tide pools, known here from two museum specimens near Punta Piuta (1966 and 1967).
note.es: Un blenio de 4 cm de costas calizas erosionadas y pozas de marea, conocido aquí por dos especímenes de museo cerca de Punta Piuta (1966 y 1967).

evidence: OBIS: 2 records in the region (mostly museum specimens)

sources.t: OBIS and GBIF museum records (UCR Zoology Museum, LACM) from Limón, Isla Uvita, Cahuita and Puerto Viejo
